Business Intelligence (BI) AnalystBusiness intelligence (BI) analysts help guide and improve the way that businesses' management staff foster collaboration within and between departments. Those who desire to work as a BI analyst should demonstrate a strong understanding of managerial and professional skill sets. BI analysts are generally tasked with collaborating with a team of cross-departmental managers, and are expected to be able to demonstrate excellent leadership capabilities.

They should also be well versed in many different aspects of business administration. Presentation skills are also a must as BI analysts are often expected to chair meetings discussing organizational data and future directions of the company. Analysts should also be prepared to lead seminars training new managers on different aspects of business intelligence. BI analysts should exhibit proficiency in many different Microsoft applications such as Word and Excel. Experience in an ERP system such as Oracle or SAP is usually considered a plus.

It is also expected that analysts will naturally demonstrate superior creative thinking and decision making abilities consistently in their work. Finally, analysts should be capable of working within a diverse, global workforce that is consumer oriented. BI Analyst Tasks: Provide application analysis and data modeling design to collect data for centralized data warehouse.

Extract data from databases and data warehouses for reporting and to facilitate sharing between multiple data systems. Proficient in the use of query and reporting analysis tools.

Standardize data collection by developing methods for database design and validation reports.

Specific Tasks: Conduct market research: identify key trends, players, and policies shaping the future of smart cities and IoT solutions. Distill market analytics and primary research into concise and relevant presentations for corporate teams – including senior leadership, product innovation, R&D, sales, and smart cities.

Engage & manage technology partners: identify best-in-class vendors in the market; drive business development & contract discussions; frame proof of concepts and pilots; introduce high-potential vendors to other stakeholders within; manage relationships with active partners.

Liaise with local teams nationally: inform local teams & regional managers of relevant smart city trends and opportunities for clients. Inversely, source smart city opportunities and trends from local teams. Uncover ways to inject fresh ideas into longstanding and prospective client relationships through the introduction of innovative technology solutions.

Evangelize new product offerings: work with product innovation teams to define & establish product-market-fit. Strategically introduce innovative solutions into existing sales channels with pilot and proof of concept engagements. Scale proven solutions by working with enterprise sales counterparts to bring new commercial offerings to market.

Data reporting & presentations: support the program by analyzing client and marketing data from Salesforce, RFP databases, direct client engagements, and marketing channels. Report key insights to program lead and senior leadership on a regular basis.

Create engaging content for internal and external purposes: Work with Senior Director to create, revise, and enhance client facing material such as pitch slides, RFP content, and proposals. Similarly, help create gripping internal presentations to educate and inform peers and leadership on a regular basis.

jobs_results.description:
Acme Manufacturing has an opportunity available for a Full-Time Business Intelligence & Reporting Analyst. This position has a starting salary range of $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 annually. The workweek for this position is full-time, Monday-Friday, on-site at our facility near I-70 and Monaco in Denver, CO. You will own and maintain datasets in SQL Server and lead initiatives in reporting, analytics, and exploring AI Integrations.


Compensation and Benefits:



Competitive starting pay

$75,000.00 - $95,000.00 annually, depending on experience.



Stable, full-time, and reliable position

Monday – Friday, 7:00am – 4:30pm, keep your weekends and evenings free.



Comprehensive benefits package

Medical, dental, vision, short term and long-term disability plans, 401(k), paid holidays, and vacation.



 Great work environment

This is an excellent opportunity to work with an established, dynamic, and growing data-driven company while leveraging your expertise in Power BI and SQL server.


 


Job Duties and Responsibilities:


Acme Manufacturing is a well-established manufacturing company focused on making advancements through automation, advanced analytics, data-driven insights, and innovative integration of legacy systems into modern architectures. As we embrace this digital transformation, we are looking for a Business Intelligence & Reporting Analyst to lead our initiatives in reporting, analytics, and exploring potential AI integrations. In this position you’ll own and maintain datasets in SQL Server, build and publish Power BI reports and dashboards, manage Power BI workspaces/permissions, and deliver insights and tools that help our teams act faster and smarter. You will work closely with our internal programming team that handles the functions and data exports from our ERP—no specific programming experience is required. Primary duties include but are not limited to:


 



Own the reporting stack: Maintain curated SQL Server tables/views for analytics; document data definitions and lineage.
Build useful reports: Design, develop, and support Power BI dashboards/reports for Finance, Operations, Sales, and HR.
Be the reporting Point-of-Contact: Intake requests, triage, prioritize, and communicate timelines/status with stakeholders.
Data quality & refreshes: Monitor scheduled refreshes, troubleshoot failures, and ensure data is timely and accurate.
Workspace administration: Manage Power BI workspaces, datasets, gateways, row-level security, and access controls.
Self-service enablement: Create certified datasets, templates, and how-tos that enable power users.
Partner with Programming Team: Align on data export schedules/formats from the ERP; validate and reconcile loads.
Ad hoc analysis: Run analyses that explain trends (e.g., margins, variances, productivity) and recommend actions.
Process improvement: Propose changes to make reporting faster, clearer, and more reliable.

 


Required Skills & Experience:



3–5 years in a reporting/BI, data analyst, or similar role (manufacturing or multi-site environment a plus).
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, technical, or business-related field.
Solid SQL skills (CTEs, window functions, performance-aware querying; ability to build views).
Hands-on Power BI experience: data modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), report design, and workspace management.
Understanding of dimensional modeling/star schemas and KPI design.
Comfort working with CSV/flat-file exports and turning them into clean, reliable tables.
Familiarity with the current AI environment and potential use cases.
Strong communication: translate business questions into datasets, metrics, and visuals.
Organized and service-oriented with good judgment on prioritization and trade-offs.

 


Preferred Qualifications: 



Experience with SQL Server Agent jobs, SSIS/ETL, or data gateways.
Familiarity with manufacturing metrics (throughput, OEE, scrap, lead times) and financial KPIs (sales, margin, variance).
Exposure to HR/time systems (e.g., UKG) and common sales/operations data sources.

 


What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)



Certified, documented datasets for core functions (e.g., sales, inventory, production, labor).
Reliable refreshes with alerting and quick resolution of failures.
A clear intake/prioritization process and SLA for report requests.
Widely adopted dashboards that leadership references in weekly/monthly reviews.
Fewer ad-hoc data fires because the right data is available, trusted, and easy to use.

 


 


If you're ready to contribute to impactful projects and grow your career in a hands-on environment, apply today!


Who we are:


Acme Manufacturing is a Denver-based company located at I-70 and Monaco, about 5 miles east of Downtown Denver. We manufacture and distribute metal products used mainly in the building trades. We employ a diverse range of people from all walks of life. Our team members are passionate about what they do, and we are in turn dedicated to our talented personnel. We believe a company is as successful as its employees, and we strive to provide a positive, inclusive, and engaging work environment. We work collaboratively as a team to achieve our goals and offer great employee perks to attract top talent, leading to life-long careers. Over the past 30 years the Acme Manufacturing family of brands has grown to include a wide variety of quality products – this includes metal shapes and sheet, garage door parts, landscape products, decorative door hardware, chain, and threaded products. A career at Acme includes advancement opportunities, cross-training between roles, employee enrichment programs and a great workplace community. We offer competitive salaries and benefits packages, as well as bonus opportunities.

Compensation Range: $75,000 - $90,000


 Location: US Based Remote


 The Mortgage Business Intelligence & Analytics team oversees all activities and functions involved with the company’s Business Intelligence platform, giving mortgage company business leaders access to reliable, actionable data to better manage and understand the business and drive company growth.


 We are seeking a Business Intelligence Reporting Analyst to focus on the development of our Power BI reporting environment. This role will do more than compile tabular data; this role will have an opportunity to use data to tell a story, and help our team, as well as business leaders, derive meaningful insights. This role will support various facets of the company including sales, HR, and Finance.


 The right candidate will have a strong background with Power BI. They will be detail oriented, with the ability to infer business needs and develop reporting solutions using data visualization best practices including leveraging Gestalt principles, Storytelling with Data, and visualization selection principals. They will proactively run data quality checks to ensure the integrity of the information being delivered. Self-motivated with an eagerness to learn, becoming a subject matter expert to coincide with technical fluency. Stays abreast of the latest Power BI features and identifies the right opportunities for implementation.


 What you will be doing:


 Report Development (50%)


 
  Build effective and efficient reports and dashboards using best practices in data presentation and design language
  Migrate existing reporting inventory to a centralized semantic model
  Automate/streamline manual processes
 
 Data Monitoring and Diagnostics (20%)


 
  Monitor reports for data discrepancies and issues through use of Power BI and SQL
  Address, diagnose, and resolve reporting issues identified by business partners
  Leverage Valtrune to complete full data and report validation
 
 Semantic Model Support (10%)


 
  Propose changes and enhancements to established semantic models to support new reporting, or improve existing reporting
  Implement minor changes to semantic models as needed
 
 Report Maintenance (10%)


 
  
   Make minor changes and updates to existing reports as needed


 
 Documentation (5%)


 
  Document report development processes for business contingency purposes
  Maintain semantic model documentation, including data sources and table relationships
  Maintain an index of all active reports, including data lineage, purpose, and audience
  Maintain reporting changelog
 
 Team Support & Other Duties (5%)


 
  Provide backfill support for ongoing team work as needed
 
 Qualifications


 
  3+ years’ experience in a data or business intelligence focused role
  3+ years creating BI dashboards and reports with a focus on data visualization and storytelling with a high proficiency using Power BI
  3+ years writing SQL queries for data mining
  3+ years’ experience collecting and documenting business requirements
  Mortgage experience highly preferred
  Experience with Financial reporting a plus
 
 Required Skills


 
  Intermediate proficiency with Power BI:
  Understand how to navigate semantic models

  Calculation groups

  Standard select queries

  Window functions and methods
  Strong written and verbal communication skills
 
 This opportunity is fully remote with the option to work from our offices in San Diego, CA, Irvine, CA, or Omaha, NE for those who prefer an office environment. You will be joining a dynamic, fully remote team which is distributed across time zones.


   Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without the need for sponsorship.
